verdict.rationale: Pipecat is a BSD-2 open-source, pip-installable, self-hostable framework (pipecat-probe-rt-2, pipecat-docs-42), and the same bot file is documented as portable across the dev runner, Pipecat Cloud, and self-hosting (pipecat-docs-32). That portability lowers lock-in and makes leaving feasible. Developers can capture their own audio recordings and transcripts in code (pipecat-docs-3, pipecat-docs-4), but there is no documented account-level export of hosted data, so the 'export all my data' part relies on self-capture rather than a vendor export feature. Missing for 10: a documented Pipecat Cloud data export or offboarding path, explicit open file formats for recordings, transcripts and metrics, and independent corroboration of migrating off the platform.
